top_creatures.label: Crown Revenant (undead boss with a guard ring)
top_creatures.why: Summons a guard set on spawn, re-summons when guards are at or below 3, power-up at 30 percent HP, and a heal on a damage-threshold condition. Silhouette and sound not in box.
top_creatures.keep: Refill threshold at 3 guards; on-spawn summon
top_creatures.change: Heal becomes a visible wind-up window; power-up becomes an aura with its own cue

top_creatures.label: Ladder Wyrm (dark dragon with HP bands)
top_creatures.why: 42 skill rows; a new move unlocks at HP bands of about 95, 75, 70, 60, 50, 40, 30, 28, 15 and 3 percent; on-spawn summon
top_creatures.keep: The HP band ladder; on-spawn summon
top_creatures.change: Four bands instead of ten; a roar cue per band; our own moves

top_creatures.label: Dragon that re-summons from zero
top_creatures.why: Summons minions only when none are left (slave count 0). HP line 6,005,000 (raw value, not interpreted).
top_creatures.keep: Zero-count summon as a clear beat after the adds are cleared
top_creatures.change: Visible call with a wing cue; capped to our 3-attacker rule

top_creatures.label: Five-colour beetle brood
top_creatures.why: One family, one size, one level (155), five elements, MVP flag on each; the quake skill appears on more than one member
top_creatures.keep: One shape, five elements, one level tier
top_creatures.change: Each element gets its own signature move, cue and palette

top_creatures.label: Gilded thief beetle
top_creatures.why: Insect, Fire, Large, Level 65, MVP; teleports away when rudely attacked. The gold look is not in the box (name only).
top_creatures.keep: Flee on a hit, return later
top_creatures.change: Our own metallic gold ramp and a thief cue

top_creatures.label: Tidal kraken tiers
top_creatures.why: One water family across four level tiers (95, 100, 124, 155); storm skill on chase, wide curse, summon at 3 slaves
top_creatures.keep: Level tiers in one silhouette; storm as a telegraphed area
top_creatures.change: Storm ring fills from the edge; tiers shown by fin and scale colour

top_creatures.label: Crowd hopper (small pack beast)
top_creatures.why: Not a boss (no Class line); while chasing, uses its self-teleport when more than four monsters are in range (condition mobnearbygt 4)
top_creatures.change: Count our hate-list members; cap at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; it repositions the pack, not the player

top_creatures.label: Demon with a retinue
top_creatures.why: Demon, Dark, Large, Level 81, MVP; two summon rules (on spawn, and at 3 or fewer slaves); same pattern as the Crown Revenant on another race
top_creatures.change: Retinue is a visible group that breaks off when the boss is hit hard (design idea, not from data)
